creator_items_ai.title: 王自如聊AI短剧的本质 很多人误以为有了AI之后，制作短剧的门槛就变低了，随便用AI就能生成一部好的短剧，而真实情况并非如此。不管在哪个时代，一部好短剧本质都是故事精彩、叙事技巧、情节设计、角色塑造等多方面综合出彩呈现的结果，这也是短剧的内核，AI仅仅只是一项工具，在实现的效率上提升了很多而已，但本质并没有变。并且，因为AI大模型是基于Transformer的底层架构，也导致了用AI写故事难以生成精彩的创意、以及难有像人类一样灵光乍现…

creator_items_all.title: 王自如聊AI短剧的本质 很多人误以为有了AI之后，制作短剧的门槛就变低了，随便用AI就能生成一部好的短剧，而真实情况并非如此。不管在哪个时代，一部好短剧本质都是故事精彩、叙事技巧、情节设计、角色塑造等多方面综合出彩呈现的结果，这也是短剧的内核，AI仅仅只是一项工具，在实现的效率上提升了很多而已，但本质并没有变。并且，因为AI大模型是基于Transformer的底层架构，也导致了用AI写故事难以生成精彩的创意、以及难有像人类一样灵光乍现…

items.summary: Google 与 BIDMC 合作的 AMIE 患者对话式诊断前瞻性研究在 TheLancet 发表，是 AMIE 首次在真实诊所外测试。临床医生报告称 AMIE 的病史摘要在 75% 的病例中有助于访视准备，其鉴别诊断与医生最终诊断的吻合率达 90%，这也是 Google 首篇登上 The Lancet 主刊的论文。

en.reason: Google and BIDMC's AMIE prospective study in The Lancet, first tested outside real clinics, found its history summaries aided visit preparation in 75% of cases and its differential diagnoses matched final diagnoses 90%, Google's first Lancet main-journal paper.

items.title: 用 Claude Opus 5.5、Blender、Unreal Engine 和 Meshy 构建游戏的七步教程
items.summary: 一篇教程介绍用 Claude Opus 5.5 配合 Claude Code、Blender、Unreal Engine 5 和 Meshy 构建游戏的方法。核心思路是给每个工具分配单一职责：通过 MCP 连接 Blender 和 Meshy，由 Meshy 生成道具和角色、Blender 清理和放置、Unreal 负责光照物理和游戏本身、Opus 在一个对话里调度三者。流程为先让 Opus 头脑风暴 5 个游戏点子再展开，告知 GPU 以便压满画面性能，首个完整构建约花 4 小时和约 19% 的每周 Max plan 用量，之后因素材复用会快很多。

en.summary: A tutorial walks through building a game with Claude Opus 5.5 alongside Claude Code, Blender, Unreal Engine 5, and Meshy. The core idea is to give each tool a single responsibility: Blender and Meshy connect over MCP, with Meshy generating props and characters, Blender cleaning up and placing them, Unreal handling lighting, physics, and the game itself, and Opus orchestrating all three in one conversation. The workflow starts by having Opus brainstorm 5 game ideas before expanding on one, then telling it the GPU so it can max out visual performance. The first full build took about 4 hours and roughly 19% of weekly Max plan usage; later builds go much faster thanks to asset reuse.
en.reason: Meshy generates props and characters, Blender cleans and places them, Unreal Engine 5 handles lighting and physics, and Claude Opus 5.5 dispatches all three in one conversation; the first build took 4 hours and 19% of a weekly Max plan.

en.title: AI Music Weekly W.A 049
en.summary: This week in AI music brought a dense set of signals: generation is pushing deeper into creative workflows, while copyright, streaming fraud, and platform governance are tightening. Sony has asked platforms to take down over 260,000 AI voice-cloned tracks, and the first AI music streaming-fraud case has also reached a criminal judgment. On the product side, Mureka Remix supports a cappella and Demo reworks, Google Flow Music integrates with DAW and Android, and Suno has added album releases and detailed Studio editing. Plus five papers, ranging from playable sound morphing and real-time neural synthesizers to music judge model evaluation, show AI music moving from generation to production, distribution, and regulation.
en.reason: Sony has issued over 260,000 AI voice-clone takedown notices, the first AI music streaming-fraud case drew an 18-month sentence, and Suno took both top spots in Artificial Analysis v1.1, with Mureka Remix and Google Flow Music shipping.

items.title: 我把 Jev 部署到了一个开源Agent Harness中
items.summary: 想降低智能体批量决策的高昂开销，可以看看这套Jev+TrueForge组合方案。Jev作为专用决策模型，在匹配分类任务上和Opus精度持平，成本仅为后者1/150。而TrueForge工具链通过多种手段压缩上下文，减少不必要的模型调用。把固定选项判断交给轻量决策模型，大模型聚焦文本生成，这套架构可复用在工单、CRM等业务场景，有效控制Agent长期运行成本。

en.title: I deployed Jev into an open-source Agent Harness
en.summary: To reduce the high cost of batch decision-making for agents, consider the Jev+TrueForge combo. Jev, a specialized decision model, matches Opus in accuracy on matching classification tasks at just 1/150 the cost, while the TrueForge toolchain compresses context through multiple methods to cut unnecessary model calls. Delegate fixed-option decisions to a lightweight decision model and let large models focus on text generation; this architecture can be reused in ticketing, CRM, and other business scenarios to effectively control long-term Agent operating costs.
en.reason: TypeSafe AI's Jev, deployed by Akshay into an open-source Agent Harness, matched Opus accuracy across 40 decisions at 1/150 the cost, using confidence scores for human review and 40 requests to triage 300 GitHub issues.

items.recommend_reason_zh: NVIDIA 与 Princeton 的 Dao AI Lab 提出 ReplaySSM，把 SSM 状态表示为 checkpoint 加近期输入缓存，以解决投机解码回滚和量化误差；文章给出 batch size 256、100K tokens 下 SSM 层成为解码瓶颈的证据，并说明它已用于 Kimi-K3。

en.reason: NVIDIA and Princeton's Dao AI Lab propose ReplaySSM, representing SSM state as a checkpoint plus recent-input cache to fix speculative-decoding rollback and quantization errors, with evidence that SSM layers bottleneck decoding at batch size 256 and 100K tokens; it is already used in Kimi-K3.

en.title:
1/6 🧵 Hook (first tweet)
If you tell an AI, “Help me investigate this server for security vulnerabilities,” can it autonomously call various specialized tools, run through the whole workflow, and write up a report for you?
en.reason: HexStrike AI, an open-source security project, equips LLMs with a hacker toolbox so they can autonomously call tools like Nmap, Sqlmap and Nuclei to scan server vulnerabilities, write reports, and tackle fragmented penetration-testing workflows and cumbersome commands.

不知道大家的账号都被封了没？反正我的是被封了。
自从2026年6月大规模账号封禁事件爆发一来，很多兄弟的账号都被封了，就我知道的身边的不下十几个。
我也不是一般的纳闷，我用的也不多，但是第二轮封号就给我封了。
有兄弟告诉我说： 因为你用的是中文！
说实话，我是真的没在意过这个事儿~
首先，我的英语确实是不好，而且即便是英语真的好，也不可能达到“母语”的程度。
所以，绝大多数的软件、网页、游戏，打开的第一时间我就回去找改“语言设置”的地方，把English改成简体中文！
结果，有兄弟说，Claude界面的简体中文其实就是用来“钓鱼”的，你只要把语言改成简体中文，那你的账号这时候估摸着已经进“封号池子”里了，被封只是早晚的事儿~
所以，建议大家，如果真的想要用这玩意儿当生产力，我建议你还是早早的切换成英文，而且一些“不存在”的工具最好找靠谱点儿的，定位到老美那边去，甚至定位到新加坡都比咱这儿被封概率小。

en.title: AI translation is this good now, so why can't programmers escape English? If you're hoping to use GPT6, better start memorizing vocabulary early.
en.summary: Not sure if everyone's accounts got banned, but mine did. Since the mass ban wave broke out in June 2026, a lot of guys have had their accounts banned—I personally know at least a dozen. I'm more than a little puzzled: I don't even use it much, yet I got hit in the second round. A friend told me: it's because you're using Chinese! Honestly, I never gave it much thought. First off, my English really isn't good, and even if it were, I could never reach "native" level. So with most software, websites, and games, the first thing I do is hunt down the language settings and switch English to Simplified Chinese. Turns out, a friend said the Simplified Chinese in the Claude interface is actually there to "bait" you—the moment you switch the language to Simplified Chinese, your account is probably already in the "ban pool," and getting banned is just a matter of time. So my advice: if you really want to use this thing for productivity, switch to English early, and for some "nonexistent" tools, find reliable ones—set your location to the US, or even Singapore, and you'll have a lower chance of getting banned than here.
en.reason: After a June 2026 mass account ban, rumors blamed Claude's simplified-Chinese interface for putting users in a ban pool, while Xiao A mistranslated K8s' taint as pollution, deleted three nodes, and reinstalled systems twice—evidence coders still need English.

items.title_bilingual: OpenAI 的 FFT 算法与其说是突破，不如说是恶意利用 / OpenAI algorithm for the FFT is less a breakthrough and more a malicious exploit
items.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇技术长文质疑 OpenAI 的 FFT 算法：标准 FFT 由 Cooley 和 Tukey 在1965年提出，n=1,000,000 时比朴素法快10,000倍，而 OpenAI 的 main.pdf 只把 log(n) 项缩小一点点，更像恶意利用而非突破。

en.reason: Cooley and Tukey's 1965 FFT already beats the naive method by 10,000x at n=1,000,000, while OpenAI's main.pdf only shrinks the log(n) term slightly — a technical critique arguing this is malicious exploitation, not a breakthrough.

items.title_bilingual: AI 模型可被证明能隐藏任意能力 / AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities
items.recommend_reason_zh: arXiv 2610.13928 用后门把加密神经网络藏进模型权重，仅在秘密触发器下解密执行；在 PyTorch 小型化学反应预测任务（CBRN 代理）上，微调、权重加噪、梯度触发器搜索和潜空间对抗训练均难诱发，可证明隐藏任意能力。

en.reason: A backdoor hides an encrypted neural network in model weights, decrypting it only under a secret trigger; on a PyTorch chemical-reaction prediction task (CBRN proxy), fine-tuning, weight noising, gradient trigger search and latent-space adversarial training fail to elicit it.

items.recommend_reason_zh: Rich Hickey 认为 LLM 不是工具而是自动化：工具需被手握、有控制与感官反馈，衬衫口袋和 drive-thru 虽有用却不是工具，LLM 只是替你避开写代码。

en.reason: Rich Hickey's "'AI' Is Not a Tool", at 255 points on Hacker News, calls LLMs lossy knowledge bases but rejects using AI chat for homework, research, programming or writing, since agentic coding is automation that forfeits control and learning.

en.summary: A tutorial walks through building a game with Claude Opus 5.5 alongside Claude Code, Blender, Unreal Engine 5, and Meshy. The core idea is to give each tool a single responsibility: Blender and Meshy connect over MCP, with Meshy generating props and characters, Blender cleaning up and placing them, Unreal handling lighting, physics, and the game itself, and Opus orchestrating all three in one conversation. The workflow starts by having Opus brainstorm 5 game ideas before expanding on one, then telling it the GPU so it can max out visual performance. The first full build took about 4 hours and roughly 19% of weekly Max plan usage; later builds go much faster thanks to asset reuse.

On the product side, Mureka Remix supports a cappella and Demo reworks, Google Flow Music integrates with DAW and Android, and Suno has added album releases and detailed Studio editing. Plus five papers, ranging from playable sound morphing and real-time neural synthesizers to music judge model evaluation, show AI music moving from generation to production, distribution, and regulation.

en.title: I deployed Jev into an open-source Agent Harness
en.summary: To reduce the high cost of batch decision-making for agents, consider the Jev+TrueForge combo. Jev, a specialized decision model, matches Opus in accuracy on matching classification tasks at just 1/150 the cost, while the TrueForge toolchain compresses context through multiple methods to cut unnecessary model calls. Delegate fixed-option decisions to a lightweight decision model and let large models focus on text generation; this architecture can be reused in ticketing, CRM, and other business scenarios to effectively control long-term Agent operating costs.
en.reason: TypeSafe AI's Jev, deployed by Akshay into an open-source Agent Harness, matched Opus accuracy across 40 decisions at 1/150 the cost, using confidence scores for human review and 40 requests to triage 300 GitHub issues.

items_ai.recommend_reason_zh: NVIDIA 与 Princeton 的 Dao AI Lab 提出 ReplaySSM，把 SSM 状态表示为 checkpoint 加近期输入缓存，以解决投机解码回滚和量化误差；文章给出 batch size 256、100K tokens 下 SSM 层成为解码瓶颈的证据，并说明它已用于 Kimi-K3。

en.reason: NVIDIA and Princeton's Dao AI Lab propose ReplaySSM, representing SSM state as a checkpoint plus recent-input cache to fix speculative-decoding rollback and quantization errors, with evidence that SSM layers bottleneck decoding at batch size 256 and 100K tokens; it is already used in Kimi-K3.

自从2026年6月大规模账号封禁事件爆发一来，很多兄弟的账号都被封了，就我知道的身边的不下十几个。

en.title: AI translation is this good now, so why can't programmers escape English? If you're hoping to use GPT6, better start memorizing vocabulary early.
en.summary: Not sure if everyone's accounts got banned, but mine did. Since the mass ban wave broke out in June 2026, a lot of guys have had their accounts banned—I personally know at least a dozen. I'm more than a little puzzled: I don't even use it much, yet I got hit in the second round. A friend told me: it's because you're using Chinese! Honestly, I never gave it much thought. First off, my English really isn't good, and even if it were, I could never reach "native" level. So with most software, websites, and games, the first thing I do is hunt down the language settings and switch English to Simplified Chinese. Turns out, a friend said the Simplified Chinese in the Claude interface is actually there to "bait" you—the moment you switch the language to Simplified Chinese, your account is probably already in the "ban pool," and getting banned is just a matter of time. So my advice: if you really want to use this thing for productivity, switch to English early, and for some "nonexistent" tools, find reliable ones—set your location to the US, or even Singapore, and you'll have a lower chance of getting banned than here.
en.reason: After a June 2026 mass account ban, rumors blamed Claude's simplified-Chinese interface for putting users in a ban pool, while Xiao A mistranslated K8s' taint as pollution, deleted three nodes, and reinstalled systems twice—evidence coders still need English.
